summary: Formats and reports an OSC script parser diagnostic. Selects a severity label (Undefined/Warning/Error/CriticalError) by the severity argument, prefixes it with "OSC %s on line %d : " using the current line number stored at this[99], optionally appends a caller-supplied message with delimiter characters, and lazily opens a log stream (this[2], opened through this+67 in wt mode) to write the formatted line. For Error and CriticalError severity only, the message is routed to a callback via sub_4986D0 when this[105] is set, otherwise shown with MessageBoxA using the Caption global, followed by a utility call and a return through ResourcePathBuilder. Called by five OSC parser functions (004920b0, 00492160, 00492460, 00492a40, 00493fc0).

operations.description: Return 0 immediately when the severity argument a2 is at most 1; only severities 2 (Error) and 3 (CriticalError) proceed past the final gate.

Build the severity label array from the four string globals aUndefinedError, aWarning_0, aError and aCriticalError, select the entry at index a2, and read the current OSC line number from field this[99] (this+0x18C).
Format the message header into Text with StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck using the aOscSOnLineD format "OSC %s on line %d : " with the severity label and the line number.

When the optional message a3 is supplied, append it to Text: write the delimiter word from asc_5C64D4 at the current end, strcat a3, then append the same delimiter word and the word_5C30B4 terminator.

Lazily open the log stream: when field this[2] (this+0x8) is null, open the log file with sub_587DB0 on this+67 using the aWt mode string and store the handle in this[2]; if opened, initialize it via sub_587F64(handle, 0, 0).
When the log stream is open, write the message header with StringFormatWithNestedIO(stream, aS_4) and then the line terminator with StringFormatWithNestedIO(stream, &word_5C30B4).
Return 0 when the severity is neither 2 nor 3; only Error and CriticalError reach the user-visible reporting path.
When field this[105] (this+0x1A4) is non-zero, route the formatted Text to the callback sub_4986D0 and return 0 instead of showing a dialog.
Show the user-visible popup MessageBoxA(0, Text, Caption, 0) using the Caption global as the title.
Call the utility UtilityFunction_9ca4 with argument 1 after the dialog path.
Return the result of ResourcePathBuilder(a2), the terminal helper of the reporting path.
